title: LCLI-680 review minors: a one-key kindSchemaVersions sentence, stale pre-LCLI-575 byte-identity comments, and a stale test docstring count
description:
Three MINOR findings from the final independent review of LCLI-680 (opum-workflow:review-assignment run wf_0c77b73f-334 on head 0c17d532, verdict APPROVE). Filed so the gap can be picked up; a gap that lives only in a closed record summary is durable but nobody can act on it. None of the three blocks LCLI-679 (ODOC-437 slice 0b): that slice touches src/core/manifest.ts, src/commands/agent.ts and the help/docs example, and none of these findings is on that path.

(1) docs/reference/cli-contract.md section 5.6 -- the LCLI-680 paragraph says `lore help --json` "now advertises kindSchemaVersions: {"agent.context.export": 3}", presenting a ONE-key map as the current manifest value. At 0c17d532 the manifest carries TWO keys: {"agent.context.export": 3, "agent.workflow.projection": 2} (measured with `bun run src/cli.ts help --json`). The paragraph four lines below already states the two-key map, so the sentence contradicts its own section. The identical false-current-value sentence sits at docs/adr/0005-cli-contract.md:50 and is corrected only later, at :59-60.

(2) src/core/agent-context.ts -- four comments still assert byte-identity to the pre-LCLI-575 compiler: lines 216-217 ("Its fields, bytes and digest are exactly the pre-LCLI-575 pack own"), line 316, lines 441-442, and line 785. LCLI-680 now changes total/shown/truncated/reason inside that same shared path (compilePack passes ordered.length as total; the footer renders it), so all four are stale and contradict the change corrected statement at src/core/agent-workflow.ts:244-251 and cli-contract section 5.6. Measured at the tip: the LCLI-289 hit-free context reports total=198 against 256 declared candidates, so the bytes are no longer the pre-LCLI-575 ones. docs/specs/agent-profile-context-retrieval.md:280 mirrors one of the stale claims ("the floor is byte-for-byte the pre-LCLI-575 one").

(3) test/lcli680-selection-zero-score-and-digest.test.ts:25 -- the docstring quotes the round-1 measurements ("selects 197 of the 254 declared candidates and the LCLI-380 pack 223"). The tip measures 198 of 198 eligible against 256 declared for LCLI-289, and 224 against 256 for LCLI-380; the CHANGELOG already carries 198. The docstring own 21/47 are correct, which isolates the selected/declared numbers as stale.

NOT CAMPAIGN WORK unless one blocks LCLI-679, which none does.
finalSummary: Corrected the three MINOR findings from LCLI-680 review; text-only, no behaviour change. (1) cli-contract section 5.6 and ADR-0005 no longer present the one-key kindSchemaVersions map as the current manifest value; both name the agent.context.export entry at 3 and point at the projection projection entry 2 below. (2) Four comments in src/core/agent-context.ts and one line of docs/specs/agent-profile-context-retrieval.md no longer claim byte-identity of the hit-free pack, or its budget floor, to the pre-LCLI-575 one; LCLI-680 eligible-deck change moves total/shown/truncated inside that same shared path. (3) The test docstring counts re-measured at the tip with the pinned bun: LCLI-289 selects 198 of 198 eligible (256 declared), LCLI-380 224 of 224 (256 declared); the 21/47 directional counts are unchanged. Verified: bun run lore check exit 0; bun test 4970 pass 0 fail; bun run lint exit 0; bun run typecheck exit 0. PR opum-ai/lore-cli#527.
